description:
List invoices

Returns one page of the selected organization's invoices, newest first: every invoice issued to it with a nonzero total or actual charges, including charges fully paid by credit; drafts and empty invoices are excluded. Each names what it charged the organization's own subscription and each project. Pass subject to list only the invoices that charge the organization itself or one of its projects, and nextCursor as cursor to read further. Listing invoices does not make a payment or modify a subscription.

API reference: https://photon.codes/docs/beta/api-reference/organization-billing/list-invoices

cursor.description: nextCursor of the page before; omitted for the first page.

limit.description: At most this many invoices, 1 to 100. 20 when omitted.

subject.description: Only the invoices that charge this subject a nonzero amount: organization for the organization's own charges, such as SSO and 10DLC, or one of its projects by id. Omitted, every invoice.

name: listInvoices

amountDueCents.description: What is left to pay, in cents, after partial payments and credit.

pageUrl.description: The invoice's page, which opens without signing in, to view and pay it. Only for an organization paying by invoice, from when the invoice is finalized.

paymentActionRequired.description: Its payment waits on the customer's authentication (3DS). Pay the invoice to complete it.

paymentOverdue.description: Unpaid past its due date. Overdue invoices set the organization's dunning stage.

paymentProcessing.description: An ACH debit is paying it and hasn't settled yet. It is not overdue meanwhile.

pdfUrl.description: The invoice's PDF, once generated. Download it with the credentials that listed it.

subjects.description: Every billing subject on the invoice, deduplicated, including one it charged nothing. Empty when none is known.

success_200_6170706c69636174696f6e2f6a73.description:
What produced the invoice.

Known values: ["subscription","one_off","credit"]. Others may be added.

Provider-neutral payment status.

Known values: ["pending","succeeded","failed"]. Others may be added.

Where the invoice is in its lifecycle, apart from its payment: draft while it can still change, finalized once issued, voided when cancelled after, and pending or failed while its taxes are still being computed.

Known values: ["draft","finalized","voided","pending","failed"]. Others may be added.

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor to read the next page. Null on the last page.

title: List invoices
